user.title: Prana Air monitor
user.description:
Enter the monitor's IP address or host name. The monitor serves its readings at the path /data on that address.

The monitor's address can change when its DHCP lease renews. A DHCP reservation or its DHCP host name (for example `esp32c3-XXXXXX`) keeps it reachable, and Home Assistant also follows it to a new address when it sees the monitor on DHCP.

discovery_confirm.description: Add the Prana Air monitor found at {host}?

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the monitor at that address.
error.not_prana_air: That address answered, but not with a Prana Air readings page.
error.no_device_id: The monitor did not show its device ID.

abort.already_configured: This monitor is already set up.
abort.not_prana_air: The discovered device is not a Prana Air monitor.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the discovered device.
abort.no_device_id: The discovered device did not show a device ID.
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different monitor.

data_description.scan_seconds: The monitor refreshes its readings every 30 seconds.
